item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: The world of metals and non-metals
item.stem: Meena is helping her mother in their kitchen in Jaipur. They are choosing materials for a vessel to heat water and for its handle. Which statement about heat conduction is not correct?

options.A: A copper vessel is suitable for heating water because copper transfers heat well.
options.B: A wooden handle is suitable because wood is a poor conductor of heat.
options.C: A steel spoon left in hot dal stays cool because steel does not conduct heat.
options.D: A plastic handle keeps the hand safe because plastic transfers heat poorly.
